name: Notification
description: An inline notification component with icon, title, message, and optional close button. Similar to Alert but designed for richer content with a distinct visual treatment.

notes: Error and warning notifications use role='alert' (assertive, interrupts screen readers).
Success and info notifications use role='status' (polite, waits for idle).
When closeable is true and onClose is provided, a dismiss button is rendered with an accessible label.
The icon is aria-hidden — decorative only.
Title is bold and rendered as a strong element.

variant.description: Semantic variant controlling color and icon.

title.description: Bold heading text for the notification.

closeable.description: Whether the close button is visible.

onClose.description: Callback to dismiss the notification. Required when closeable is true.

do: Use 'error' for errors or destructive consequences.
Use 'warning' for non-critical cautions that require attention.
Use 'success' for confirmations of completed actions.
Always include a title — never an empty notification.
dont: Do not use Notification for transient messages — use Toast or Snackbar.
Do not use 'error' for general information.
Do not place multiple notifications on a page when one summary would suffice.
